title: How Interstellar’s Docking Uses Relative Motion to Turn Chaos into a Stable Target

narration.script: What visual cue lets us follow the ENDurance as it docks amid chaos? A dark docking module silhouettes against bright planet surface, tiny debris swirling. A side‑lit crew member†focused stare anchors the view, implying synced spin. The camera locks on the rear port, centering the circular opening in void. The dock mechanism clicks, and the steady frame finally reveals the precise lock.
